s: September 3, 2025 - While I can’t find specific numbers on how buyback programs help in the reduction of furniture waste, I am certain such action is a step in the right direction. By taking back their old products, brands can build customer loyalty, improve their reputation, and even save money by refurbishing and reselling furniture.
